Author: wah
Name: wahventory (Refresh Fork)
Description:
An inventory management plugin
• Smart safety filters
• Market price integration via Universalis
• Bulk discard functionality
• Category grouping and search
• Gearset protection
• /wahventory refresh command (MagicalMontra fork)
• Refresh/discard completion reporting
• Inventory right-click discard and blacklist submenu
• Market price filters and quality-specific pricing methods
Punchline: Advanced inventory management with safety filters and auto-discard
Changelog: Adds market price above/below filters that wait for refresh completion, selectable Universalis listing/sale-average methods, HQ/NQ and world isolation, and market upload timestamps. Unknown prices stay visible and are excluded from priced discard queues.
